title.narrative: Labour Action: Collaborative Effort for Accountable and Inclusive Employment

description.narrative: The Action aims at strengthening protection of labour rights in Armenia with special focus on youth and vulnerable groups. Three main activities are foreseen:i) Data innovations and cross-sectoral partnership for better observance of labour standards;ii) Enhance the capacity of CSOs and community groups to do shadow monitoring of labour rights in private and public sectors;iii) Enhance capacity of national and local government bodies to comply with labour laws.
